services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: If you’re an avid saltwater angler, you’re probably familiar with Naples fishing. If you’ve never experienced it for yourself, you’ve probably heard about how great the fishing grounds are around Southwest Florida. While most fishermen come to test their skills against tarpon, snook, or king mackerel, another fish’s abundant in the Naples waters, and it’s just as much fun to catch. I am talking about Naples shark fishing! Naples shark fishing is some of the best in Florida. Local species include lemon sharks, blacktip sharks, Atlantic sharp-nose sharks, hammerheads, nurse sharks, spinners, and tough bull sharks. blurb: Ms. B. Haven Fishing & Eco Charters offers fishing trips in the Gulf of Mexico including offshore, inshore, and sampler trips suitable for all ages and skill levels. Trips are guided by experienced native captains with over 35 years of experience. They also offer sightseeing and eco tours such as dolphin watching and shelling, as well as sunset cruises.
